AcceptExistingIn.description: An Invitation taken by the account its address already has: the account's password.
AcceptExistingIn.title: AcceptExistingIn

AcceptInvitationIn.description: A new account from an Invitation.
AcceptInvitationIn.title: AcceptInvitationIn

AccessRequestIn.description:
A request for lecturer access from the public form «Be om lærertilgang» (Story 3.13).
Each field answers its own code: `name_empty`/`name_too_long`, `invalid_email`, and the
Institution name codes.
AccessRequestIn.title: AccessRequestIn

AccessRequestListOut.description:
A page of open requests in the list envelope, newest first: `next_cursor` is null on the
last page.
AccessRequestListOut.title: AccessRequestListOut

AccessRequestOut.description: One open request on «Brukere og roller» (Story 3.13).
AccessRequestOut.title: AccessRequestOut

AdaptedOut.description:
The Adapted items' one line: their total weight in force and its default (30 % in the
shipped set), and how many replacement Core items a Student with fewer than 10 own Orders
gets in their place, with the same total weight (FR-53).
AdaptedOut.title: AdaptedOut

AdaptedPreviewItemOut.description:
One Adapted item template filled for the sample Student (Story 11.9): its id, the Game it
reads (`game`, the Class game, or `replay`), its fact kind, its weight (its share of the
Adapted total) and the code-rendered text; `text` is None when the sample has no such fact.
AdaptedPreviewItemOut.title: AdaptedPreviewItemOut

AdaptedPreviewOut.description:
The Adapted item preview (Story 11.9, FR-53, UX-DR70): the template version the Class
session pins (pinned once locked, the latest before), whether it is a draft (issue #16),
whether the lock has pinned it, the Adapted total weight in force, and each template filled
from the static sample facts set («Demodata»).
AdaptedPreviewOut.title: AdaptedPreviewOut

AddressProblem.description: Why a value is not an address (Story 4.3, FR-7). The web app words each one.
AddressProblem.title: AddressProblem

AdjustmentIn.description:
«Lagre tilrettelegging» (Story 8.9): the factor and the share. There is no field for a
reason, so no health data is stored (UX-DR53, C-1).
AdjustmentIn.title: AdjustmentIn

AdjustmentOut.description: A Student's Tilrettelegging as the Lecturer reads it (Story 8.9, FR-17).
AdjustmentOut.title: AdjustmentOut

AiAssessmentOut.description:
The «KI-vurdering» switch of a Class session (Story 12.1, FR-61), stored by
`modules/assessment`.
AiAssessmentOut.title: AiAssessmentOut

AiDescriptionsOut.description:
The plain-language Norwegian description of each AI player type, from
`players.service.describe` (FR-33): Markdown with a title line, paragraphs and `- ` lists.
AiDescriptionsOut.title: AiDescriptionsOut

AiMode.description: Who holds the AI Seats of the Class session's games (FR-15).
AiMode.title: AiMode

AllocationConfirmIn.description: «Bekreft fordeling» (Story 5.9): the draft the Lecturer is looking at.
AllocationConfirmIn.title: AllocationConfirmIn

AllocationDraftOut.description:
The stored draft (Story 5.8, FR-20): what the preview shows, never a recomputation.
Story 5.9 confirms it by `id` and `revision`.
AllocationDraftOut.title: AllocationDraftOut

AllocationGameOut.description: One Class game of the draft: its number and its four Seats, Fabrikk first.
AllocationGameOut.title: AllocationGameOut

AllocationMoveIn.description:
Move or swap in the allocation (Story 5.10): the draft the Lecturer is looking at, the
Seat of the Student who moves, and the Seat they move to. A Student in that Seat takes the
first Seat (a swap).
AllocationMoveIn.title: AllocationMoveIn

AllocationOut.description:
The «Fordeling» block: the registered Students now, those of them not in the draft (they
registered after it was drawn), and the draft, None until one is drawn.
AllocationOut.title: AllocationOut

AllocationSeatOut.description:
One Seat of a Class game in the draft (Story 5.8). `user_id` None is an empty Seat (an AI
player at the lock). `name` is resolved now through `classes.service.student_names`; None
with a `user_id` means the Student is no longer in the Class.
AllocationSeatOut.title: AllocationSeatOut

AllocationStudentOut.description: A registered Student without a Seat (Story 5.13).
AllocationStudentOut.title: AllocationStudentOut

AnotherRoundIn.description: «Send svar» on «Ville du spilt en runde til?»: yes or no.
AnotherRoundIn.title: AnotherRoundIn

AnotherRoundOut.description:
Whether the Student would have wanted to play another round (Story 10.8, FR-50, SM-10):
their own answer, None until they give one. Never anyone else's.
AnotherRoundOut.title: AnotherRoundOut

AuditActor.description: An actor of the log for the filter: a User with their name, or the system (both null).
AuditActor.title: AuditActor

AuditEventOut.description: One audit row with names resolved at read time. No actor (`actor_id` null) is the system.
AuditEventOut.title: AuditEventOut

AuditListOut.description:
A page of audit rows in the list envelope, newest first; `next_cursor` is null on the last
page.
AuditListOut.title: AuditListOut

AuditTarget.description:
One id the action touched: its key in the row (`user_id`, `invitation_id`, …) and what the
owning module calls it now; `label` is null when no module knows it.
AuditTarget.title: AuditTarget

AxisOut.description: A drawn item's value axis (Story 11.14): the range its graph's points are placed in.
AxisOut.title: AxisOut

Believability.description:
The believability question of one Game for the Student who reads it (Story 10.8, FR-70):
whether they are asked, and their own answer once given. Never anyone else's.
Believability.title: Believability

BelievabilityIn.description: «Send svar» on the believability question: 1 (not believable) to 5 (very believable).
BelievabilityIn.title: BelievabilityIn

BillOut.description:
The Debrief's extra lines under Kjedens regning (Story 9.8, FR-44, UX-DR36), every number
from the stored facts set of the Student's own Seat (AD-7). The Role rows and Kjedens kostnad
over tid are the game result's (`/api/me/games/{id}/result`, Story 6.18).
BillOut.title: BillOut

BounceClass.description:
Why a mail did not reach its address: `hard` the provider calls permanent (the address
does not exist or refuses mail), `soft` every other bounce (a full mailbox, a server down).
BounceClass.title: BounceClass

BouncedRegistration.description:
The registration status of an address whose Invitation bounced; Story 4.7 lists it with
the other statuses.
BouncedRegistration.title: BouncedRegistration

ChainOut.description:
Step 3, the whole chain (Story 9.5, FR-44, UX-DR33, UX-DR34): all four Roles, Fabrikk
first (upstream first, the order the Ordrestolper rows and the scrubber's reading take), each
with every logged Uke, oldest first. Every number is the api's (AD-10).
ChainOut.title: ChainOut

ChainRoleOut.description:
One Role of the whole chain: every Uke, and from the stored facts set (Story 9.1, AD-7) its
Forsterkning and the first Uke with an Order of `large_order` or more.
ChainRoleOut.title: ChainRoleOut

ChainWeekCost.description: The chain's cost from Uke 1 through `week`, summed over its Roles.
ChainWeekCost.title: ChainWeekCost

ChainWeekOut.description:
One Uke of one Role in the whole chain (Story 9.5): its Order and the Week state it saw
when it ordered (the Decision log's `state_seen`, as the play screen showed it).
ChainWeekOut.title: ChainWeekOut

Choice.description: The answers to «Har du spilt et spill som ligner dette før?»; `skipped` is «Hopp over».
Choice.title: Choice

ClassCostOut.description:
«Klassens kostnad» (Story 7.6, FR-39, AD-10): over the finished Class games, the median and
quartiles of their chain costs for the Kostnadsfordeling, the chain's mean lager and restordre
per game and each Role's mean, Detaljist first. Computed by `analysis.class_cost`.
ClassCostOut.title: ClassCostOut

ClassIn.description:
A new Class (Story 4.1). The service checks the fields and answers every refused one in
`fields`: `name`, `institution_id` (`institution_missing`, `institution_unknown`) and
`course_code`.
ClassIn.title: ClassIn

ClassListItem.description: One Class on the Lærerhjem: «Klassene dine».
ClassListItem.title: ClassListItem

ClassListOut.description: The Classes the User is staff of, by name. No paging: a Lecturer has a handful.
ClassListOut.title: ClassListOut

ClassOut.description: One Class with its Institution's name and the User's staff role in it.
ClassOut.title: ClassOut

ClassOverviewOut.description:
The Oversikt of a Class session (Story 7.1, FR-39, AD-25): its Class games in the list
envelope, by game number, the headline counts and the database clock (`server_now`).
ClassOverviewOut.title: ClassOverviewOut

ClassSessionListOut.description: The Class sessions of one Class, newest first. No paging: a Class has a handful.
ClassSessionListOut.title: ClassSessionListOut

ClassSessionOut.description: One Class session as its Class's staff read it.
ClassSessionOut.title: ClassSessionOut

ClassSessionSaveIn.description:
«Lagre Klasseøkt». The screen sends the AI mode, Effort level and Debrief mode as chosen
(Story 5.5), the four dates (Story 5.2) and the Game settings (Story 5.3) with the Demand
pattern and its seed (Story 5.4), and the obligatory mark, its required share and the
Inactivity limit (Story 5.7); a field left out keeps its value. `game_settings` is laid over
the stored settings, so a setting left out keeps its value. With Rule-based players no Effort
level is in force, and a sent one is ignored.
ClassSessionSaveIn.title: ClassSessionSaveIn

ColumnOut.description:
A number item's column (Story 11.5): a Starting task item from the Class session's pinned
Starting task (`starting_task`), or an Interactive number item's own column. Its prompt and
hint, the column's heading, the given rows, the asked row's label and whether the answer may
be negative. No expected value and no result.
ColumnOut.title: ColumnOut

ColumnRowOut.description: A given row of a number item's column.
ColumnRowOut.title: ColumnRowOut

CompletionOut.description:
The Student's Completion status as `reports.service.completion_status` gives it (FR-17).
`requirement_met` is None when the Class session is not obligatory. The shares are whole
percents rounded down, None without a Class game snapshot; `required_share` is the one that
applies to this Student, `adjusted` whether it is their own (Story 8.9).
CompletionOut.title: CompletionOut

CompletionSectionOut.description:
«Fullføring»: the Completion status per step and whether an obligatory requirement is met
(FR-17, FR-58). The shares are whole percents; `required_share` the one that applies to the
Student; `share_game` which game the shares come from when there is an Oppfølgingsspill.
CompletionSectionOut.title: CompletionSectionOut

CompletionStepOut.description:
One step of the «Fullføring» block: whether its step event is recorded and when, whether it
counts as done after the share, the minimums and any correction, and whether a correction
decided it (Story 13.1), with that correction (Story 13.3).
CompletionStepOut.title: CompletionStepOut

CopiedFromOut.description: The source of a copied Class session, as the Klasseøkt names it.
CopiedFromOut.title: CopiedFromOut

CopyIn.description:
«Lag kopi» (Story 5.18, FR-66): the Class session to copy, and whether to keep its demand
seed (a fresh one is drawn otherwise).
CopyIn.title: CopyIn

CopySourceListOut.description: The Class sessions a rerun may copy, newest first. No paging: a Lecturer has a handful.
CopySourceListOut.title: CopySourceListOut

CopySourceOut.description: A Class session the Lecturer may copy: one of a Class they are staff of.
CopySourceOut.title: CopySourceOut

CorrectionIn.description: «Lagre retting» (Story 13.3, FR-17): the step, its new status and the required reason.
CorrectionIn.title: CorrectionIn

CorrectionOut.description:
The correction of a step that applies, the latest (Story 13.3): the status it set, the
Lecturer's reason, when, and who made it by their name now (None when the name is no longer
known in the Class). For the staff of the Class only; never served to a Student.
CorrectionOut.title: CorrectionOut

CostLine.description: One part of this Week's cost: units on the end-of-Week balance times the rate.
CostLine.title: CostLine

CostSum.description: Holding and backlog cost and their sum, in kroner (Story 6.18).
CostSum.title: CostSum

DatesIn.description: The four dates as the Lecturer set them, each an instant with its offset or None.
DatesIn.title: DatesIn

DeadlineExtensionIn.description:
«Lagre frist» on the Studentside (Story 11.13, FR-18): the Student's own Test deadline,
with its time zone. There is no field for a reason.
DeadlineExtensionIn.title: DeadlineExtensionIn

DebriefMode.description: How the Debrief is held (FR-16): the four of a Class game together, or each alone.
DebriefMode.title: DebriefMode

DebriefOut.description:
The Student's Debrief session: its id (the `debrief:<id>` topic, AD-8), the game it
reviews and the step pointer. Never the demand series, the number of Weeks or another
Seat's numbers (FR-14): those come with the steps that reveal them, after the Explanation.
DebriefOut.title: DebriefOut

DebriefRelease.description:
When the Debriefs open (Story 9.2, FR-42): `open`, each Student's once their own Class
game has finished (the default; it can reveal the Demand pattern to Students still playing),
or `hold`, every Debrief once all Class games have finished.
DebriefRelease.title: DebriefRelease

DebriefSectionOut.description:
«Debrief» (Story 13.10, FR-58, FR-47): the Explanation as written (null: not sent); when
the Debrief was finished (null: not finished) and whether after the Debrief deadline; the
summary's key moments and the line that ties them together; the reflection answers on
evidence and structure; the quiz attempts up to the pass and whether it is passed.
DebriefSectionOut.title: DebriefSectionOut

DebriefStepOut.description:
A Debrief step after step 1, reached only with a saved Explanation (FR-41, FR-43). Step 2
carries the reveal (Story 9.4), step 3 the whole chain (Story 9.5), step 4 the own moments
(Story 9.7) and the Debrief's lines under Kjedens regning (Story 9.8); step 5, the Debrief quiz,
has routes of its own (`/quiz`, Story 9.9) and answers the step number only here.
DebriefStepOut.title: DebriefStepOut

DemandFixed.description: A fixed series: `values[w - 1]` is the demand in Week w.
DemandFixed.title: DemandFixed

DemandRandom.description: Discrete uniform demand over `mean - spread` to `mean + spread`, never below 0.
DemandRandom.title: DemandRandom

DemandSeriesOut.description:
The customer demand of Weeks 1 to the last, as the engine materialises it from the stored
Demand pattern and seed (Story 5.4, FR-13): `demand[w - 1]` is the demand in Week w. For the
Class's staff only; no Student-facing answer carries it (AD-3).
DemandSeriesOut.title: DemandSeriesOut

DemandStep.description: Customer demand `start` until `change_week`, then `new_level` from that Week on.
DemandStep.title: DemandStep

DemandStepNoise.description: A step in the mean with discrete uniform noise of `spread` around it.
DemandStepNoise.title: DemandStepNoise

EnrolledClassListOut.description: The Classes the User is a Student in, by name. No paging: a Student has a handful.
EnrolledClassListOut.title: EnrolledClassListOut

EnrolledClassOut.description: A Class the User is a Student in (Story 4.5): what Hjem names.
EnrolledClassOut.title: EnrolledClassOut

EnrolledLabHourOut.description: An upcoming Lab hour as a Student reads it (Story 5.6, FR-19), for Epic 6's Hjem.
EnrolledLabHourOut.title: EnrolledLabHourOut

EnrolledSessionOut.description:
A Class session as its Student reads it (Story 5.2, FR-18, AD-3): the dates and the next
deadline that applies. Never the Game settings, the number of Weeks or the demand.
EnrolledSessionOut.title: EnrolledSessionOut

ExplanationIn.description:
«Send Forklaring»: the text as typed. It must hold more than white space and at most
5000 characters (422 `validation_error`).
ExplanationIn.title: ExplanationIn

ExplanationOut.description:
A stored Explanation (FR-41, AD-14): the text as typed, its length in characters and when
it was saved. Never changed after it is stored.
ExplanationOut.title: ExplanationOut

FillSeatsIn.description: «Sett inn 9 KI-spillere»: the Seats the page or Spillinnsikt listed (Story 8.12).
FillSeatsIn.title: FillSeatsIn

FilledSeatsOut.description: What the fill did (Story 8.12): the AI players put in and the Seats skipped. Real counts.
FilledSeatsOut.title: FilledSeatsOut

FollowUpAnswerOut.description:
A follow-up question with its answer (Story 9.15, FR-45, AD-7): `answered` carries the hint
text code rendered from the model's choice of templates and facts, marked by `ai_generated`;
`declined` (outside the Game) and `unanswered` (no answer could be given: the call failed or
its output was rejected) carry none, and the web app shows a fixed line. Only `answered` and
`declined` are stored; `asked_at` is null for `unanswered`.
FollowUpAnswerOut.title: FollowUpAnswerOut

FollowUpIn.description:
A follow-up question about the Student's own Game (Story 9.15): as typed. It must hold more
than white space and at most 500 characters (422 `validation_error`).
FollowUpIn.title: FollowUpIn

FollowUpOut.description:
The follow-up field under the reflection questions (Story 9.15, FR-45, FR-15): `off` when
the Class session's Debrief AI text is off, no provider may answer, the pinned templates hold
no hints or the Seat has no fact to point to (the field is not shown); `closed` after the
Student's Test deadline or once their Individual test has opened; else `open`. `asked` holds
the Student's own stored questions, oldest first.
FollowUpOut.title: FollowUpOut

FunnelStageOut.description: One stage of the Trakt (Story 7.6, FR-39): how many registered Students reached it.
FunnelStageOut.title: FunnelStageOut

GameInsightOut.description:
Spillinnsikt (Story 7.7, FR-62, AD-3, AD-12): one Game week by week, for the staff of its
Class only. The only answer that gives the staff the full chain, the demand series and the
number of Weeks. Seats and Roles in chain order, the Role serving the customer first.
GameInsightOut.title: GameInsightOut

GameResult.description:
A finished Game's cost (Story 6.18, FR-28): each Role's, the chain's, and the chain's
running cost per Uke. Numbers and Roles only: no names, no demand, no settings.
GameResult.title: GameResult

GameRulesOut.description:
The rules «Regler før første ordre» states (Story 6.2, FR-84), from the Class session's
frozen settings: the delays, the number of Veiledede uker and the two cost rates. Never the
number of Weeks, the demand, its seed or the largest Order (FR-14, AD-3).
GameRulesOut.title: GameRulesOut

GameSectionOut.description:
«Klassespill» or «Oppfølgingsspill» (Story 13.8): `game` null when the Student has no
game with an opened Week; the section then says so.
GameSectionOut.title: GameSectionOut

GameSettings.description: Everything that defines a Game's arithmetic. `GameSettings()` is the Classic game.
GameSettings.title: GameSettings

GameStatus.description:
A Game's status as staff see it (FR-39), from `games.rules.game_status` only (AD-2);
`paused` from Story 8.6 (FR-89).
GameStatus.title: GameStatus

GameWeeksOut.description:
Every opened Week of a Class game (Story 7.2, AD-25): the Matrisevegg's cells, read
on demand per Game. The finished state after the last Week is not a Week and is left out.
GameWeeksOut.title: GameWeeksOut

GroupMemberOut.description:
A joined Student of a Group debrief as the other joined Students see them (Story 9.11,
FR-43): the Roster name now (None once no longer a Student of the Class), whether it is the
caller, whether their Explanation is sent and whether they have finished the shared step. Never
the text of their Explanation or answers.
GroupMemberOut.title: GroupMemberOut

GroupOut.description:
A Group debrief's shared step pointer (Story 9.11, FR-43): `step` 1 to 3 is shared, 4 means
each Student works alone from the reflection questions on. `move_on_at` is when the opener may
move every joined Student on (database time). `members` only for a joined caller, else
empty. Story 9.12: `opener` is whoever may move on now (the earliest-joined Student still
there once the opener has gone); `alone` says why the caller goes on as a Personal debrief
(`left`, `dropout`, `fallback`, `missed`), from shared step `alone_from`; both None
otherwise.
GroupOut.title: GroupOut

GuideCriterionOut.description: One coded criterion, read-only in v1: its code, its wording and its weight in %.
GuideCriterionOut.title: GuideCriterionOut

GuideQuestionOut.description:
One question of the Scoring guide as the Lecturer reads it: a long-answer question or an
Adapted item template, its title, its guide text in force, the default text it derives from,
whether the two differ («Endret», else «Standard») and its criteria.
GuideQuestionOut.title: GuideQuestionOut

InRoomIn.description:
«Marker som i rommet, 10 min» (Story 8.11): the in-room limit in whole minutes. Any number
is taken here; the command answers 422 `minutes_out_of_range` unless it is whole and from 2
to 120.
InRoomIn.title: InRoomIn

InRoomOut.description:
«I rommet til kl. 16:00. En KI-spiller tar setet etter 10 min uten ordre.» (Story 8.11,
FR-36, UX-DR62): until when, and the reader's own whole minutes (Tilrettelegging included,
never another Student's).
InRoomOut.title: InRoomOut

IndividualItemOut.description:
One item of the Student's frozen Individual test (Story 11.3), in order: its number from 1,
its type and its text; a choice item's option ids (Story 11.4, `[]` for other types), a table or
drawn item's value table (Story 11.14) or a number item's column (Story 11.5, null otherwise or
when the item has none) and the Student's saved answer (null before the first save). An Adapted
item (Story 11.7) is answered as a long answer; its `title` is its frozen text, and `wording`
carries that text with whether an AI wrote it (null for every other type). No weight, no answer
key, no rule, no fact and no score are sent to the Student.
IndividualItemOut.title: IndividualItemOut

InfoVisibility.description:
Information visibility (cut list, FR-83): which neighbour each Seat sees, with its current
inventory and backlog. Both views off by default; the Factory has no upstream neighbour and
the Retailer no downstream one, so their view on that side shows nothing.
InfoVisibility.title: InfoVisibility

InsightInRoomOut.description:
«I rommet til 16:00. KI tar over etter 10 min uten ordre.» on Spillinnsikt (Story 8.11,
FR-36, UX-DR52): the Lab hour's end and the in-room limit in whole minutes.
InsightInRoomOut.title: InsightInRoomOut

InsightLinkOut.description:
A link for one Seat's Student on Spillinnsikt (FR-62), from a provider a later module
registered (`games.service.register_insight_links`, Epic 9): `kind` names it, the page words
it; `href` is a path in the web app.
InsightLinkOut.title: InsightLinkOut

InsightPauseOut.description:
The Pause in force on Spillinnsikt (Story 8.7, FR-89, UX-DR52): «Pause siden ma. 14:10,
satt av Sara.» or «… satt av deg.», with the agreed time if any.
InsightPauseOut.title: InsightPauseOut

InsightSeatOut.description: A Seat of the Game on Spillinnsikt as held now, like the Oversikt's, with its links.
InsightSeatOut.title: InsightSeatOut

InsightWeekOut.description:
One Seat in one opened Week (Story 7.7, FR-62, AD-1): the values the engine stored in the
Week state, the Order from the Decision log, who held the Seat and its marks (AD-15).
InsightWeekOut.title: InsightWeekOut

InstitutionChoicesOut.description: The Institutions a new Class may belong to, by name («Lag Klasse»).
InstitutionChoicesOut.title: InstitutionChoicesOut

InstitutionIn.description:
The name of a new or renamed Institution (Story 3.11). Checked by `institution_name` in the
service: a bad name answers `fields.name` with its code.
InstitutionIn.title: InstitutionIn

InstitutionListOut.description:
A page of Institutions in the list envelope, newest first: `next_cursor` is null on the
last page.
InstitutionListOut.title: InstitutionListOut

InstitutionOut.description: One Institution (Story 3.11): what the Admin's list shows and what other modules read.
InstitutionOut.title: InstitutionOut

IntRange.description: Every whole number from `minimum` to `maximum`, both included; one is drawn per seed.
IntRange.title: IntRange

InvitationBounce.description: A Roster address whose newest Invitation bounced, not registered and not removed.
InvitationBounce.title: InvitationBounce

InvitationCheckOut.description: What «Du er invitert» shows for a usable link.
InvitationCheckOut.title: InvitationCheckOut

InvitationIn.description: An Invitation to an account role (Story 3.7).
InvitationIn.title: InvitationIn

InvitationKind.description:
What an Invitation offers: an account role (Story 3.7), a place on a Class's Roster as a
Student (Story 4.4), or a place in one Class's staff as Assistant lecturer (Story 4.9).
InvitationKind.title: InvitationKind

InvitationListItem.description: The newest Invitation to one address and role, on «Brukere og roller» (Story 3.10).
InvitationListItem.title: InvitationListItem

InvitationListOut.description: A page of Invitations in the list envelope: `next_cursor` is null on the last page.
InvitationListOut.title: InvitationListOut

InvitationStatus.description:
An Invitation as the Admin's list states it (Story 3.10). Expiry is read from `expires_at`
against the api's clock; a voided Invitation that was never accepted reads as expired.
InvitationStatus.title: InvitationStatus

InvitationSummaryOut.description:
The counts of the Class's Student Invitations, computed by the api at read time, and the
addresses the mail did not reach, by address. `sent`: handed to the mail provider; `bounced`:
of those, reported bounced; `accepted`: accepted (Story 4.5); `expired`: neither accepted nor
voided, and past their last valid day now. Each counts Invitations, not addresses.
InvitationSummaryOut.title: InvitationSummaryOut

InvitationTokenIn.description: The token of an Invitation link, from the fragment of `/invitasjon#<token>` (Story 3.8).
InvitationTokenIn.title: InvitationTokenIn

ItemResultOut.description:
The stored answer and its score. Only for an answered item: the answer key is never sent
before.
ItemResultOut.title: ItemResultOut

LabHourIn.description:
A Lab hour as the Lecturer adds or changes it (Story 5.6, FR-19): its start and end as
instants with their offset, and its place. The service judges the rules (`invalid_lab_hour`),
so a blank or long place gets its reason rather than a schema error.
LabHourIn.title: LabHourIn

LabHourOut.description: A Lab hour as the Class's staff read it, UTC; the web app shows it in Europe/Oslo.
LabHourOut.title: LabHourOut

LargestOrderOut.description: The Student's largest Order and the first Uke they placed it («Din ordre, 24 i Uke 11»).
LargestOrderOut.title: LargestOrderOut

LecturerOverviewOut.description:
The Lærerhjem's «Venter» and «Neste frist» (Story 5.2, UX-DR56): over the User's Classes
that are not archived.
LecturerOverviewOut.title: LecturerOverviewOut

ManualRegistrationIn.description:
«Registrer manuelt»: the address and the Student's name (used only when the address has
no account yet). `roster_entry_id` is the Roster row the form was opened from: when the

`upload_row` is the staged invalid row it was opened from, which is deleted. A refused
address answers 422 `invalid_request` with `fields.email` (an address problem or
`already_registered`), a refused name with `fields.name` (`name_empty`, `name_too_long`).

MessageFormOut.description: What the Meldingsskjema shows before a send (UX-DR46).
MessageFormOut.title: MessageFormOut

MomentOut.description:
One own moment (Story 9.7, FR-44): its texts rendered by code from the stored facts set,
the other Roles' numbers that Uke, and `seen`, the Seat's Week as it saw it when it ordered
(the Decision log's `state_seen`, for «Dette så du»).
MomentOut.title: MomentOut

MomentsOut.title: MomentsOut

MyExplanationOut.description: The Student's own Explanation in this Debrief, or None before it is sent.
MyExplanationOut.title: MyExplanationOut

MyMessageOut.description: One Message on the Student's Hjem (Story 7.10): plain text, shown as written.
MyMessageOut.title: MyMessageOut

MySummaryOut.description: The Student's own Debrief summary, `summary` None until «Fullfør Debriefen».
MySummaryOut.title: MySummaryOut

MyTestOut.description:
The Student's Individual test (Story 11.3, FR-51): `statement` until they accept the
own-work statement (no item is served), `open` once they have (the items of their attempt in
order; the statement is not asked again), `closed` when their Test deadline passed with no
attempt. `test_deadline` is the Student's effective Test deadline (none set: null);
`opened_at` when they accepted the statement. Once handed in (Story 11.10), `submitted` by
the Student or `auto_submitted` at the deadline (Story 11.11), with `submitted_at`: the items
and saved answers stay readable, never with a score (FR-54).

In one timed sitting (Story 11.12): `time_limit_minutes` is the Student's own limit (their
time factor applied, whole minutes rounded up; null when the test is not timed),
`sitting_ends_at` when their sitting ends once opened, `answering_ends_at` the earlier of that
and the Test deadline, `server_now` the API's clock for the time left, and `sitting_ended`
whether the sweep handed the attempt in at the sitting's end.
MyTestOut.title: MyTestOut

NeighbourNumber.description: One number about a neighbouring Seat, labelled with its Role and the Week it refers to.
NeighbourNumber.title: NeighbourNumber

NetInventoryOut.description:
«Ditt netto lager, hele spillet» (Story 9.3, step 1): the Student's own Seat only, every
logged Uke, oldest first. No demand and no other Seat (FR-14, FR-41).
NetInventoryOut.title: NetInventoryOut

NetWeekOut.description:
One Uke of the Student's own Netto lager (Story 9.3): inventory minus backlog as their
Seat saw it when ordering that Uke (the Decision log's `state_seen`).
NetWeekOut.title: NetWeekOut

NotMetStudentOut.description:
One Student who has not met the requirement (Story 13.6, FR-17), from
`reports.service.completion_status`.
NotMetStudentOut.title: NotMetStudentOut

OfferedEffortLevelOut.description:
An Effort level the Class session may use (Story 5.5, FR-78), as the model config holds it
and `ai.config.offered_effort_levels` offers it: nothing here is written by `sessions`.
OfferedEffortLevelOut.title: OfferedEffortLevelOut

OrderIn.description:
The Student's Order for the open Week (Story 6.12): one whole number; the command checks
it lies from 0 to the Game settings maximum (`order_invalid`).
OrderIn.title: OrderIn

OrderPreview.description:
Coefficients for the live Order preview (AD-10): with a typed Order x, the supply line
becomes `supply_line_base + x` and the position `position_base + x`; the Order reaches

OrderPreview.title: OrderPreview

OtherSeenOut.description: What another Role saw in the moment's Uke (the facts set's `others_seen`).
OtherSeenOut.title: OtherSeenOut

OverviewAiOut.description:
The AI players on the Oversikt (Story 7.6, UX-DR69): the Seats an AI player holds now and
the Class games with at least one («22 KI-spillere i 17 spill, alle merket.»).
OverviewAiOut.title: OverviewAiOut

OverviewAlertOut.description:
The Varselbånd (Story 7.11, FR-39, UX-DR45): the Class game chosen by the api, closest to
Takeover (Story 8.3), the Seat whose due time comes first, since when it waits and when the
AI player takes it over.
OverviewAlertOut.title: OverviewAlertOut

OverviewCountsOut.description:
The headline counts by status (FR-39): «41 ferdig · 15 pågår (herav 2 pauset) · 4 venter».
`running` counts the paused games too, and `paused` says how many of them are (Story 8.6).
OverviewCountsOut.title: OverviewCountsOut

OverviewGameOut.description: One Class game on the Oversikt, from its `game_summaries` row (Story 7.1, AD-25).
OverviewGameOut.title: OverviewGameOut

OverviewSeatOut.description:
A Seat of a Class game on the Oversikt (Story 7.1): its Role and who holds it, a Student
by the name they have now, any AI player as «KI-spiller» (`ai`), or free.
OverviewSeatOut.title: OverviewSeatOut

OverviewWaitOut.description:
A Student Seat the Class game waits for (FR-25), and since when on the database clock; the
web app counts the wait from `server_now`.
OverviewWaitOut.title: OverviewWaitOut

OwnAdjustmentOut.description:
The reading Student's own Tilrettelegging on Hjem (Story 8.9, UX-DR53): only they ever read
it. Each part is None when it does not apply.
OwnAdjustmentOut.title: OwnAdjustmentOut

ParticipationOut.description:
Participation signals, information only: they never change the Completion status (FR-17).
The seconds spent on the Student's own Orders, how many own Orders there are, and whether the
own Orders after the Guided Weeks were constant (None with fewer than two).
ParticipationOut.title: ParticipationOut

PauseOut.description:
The game's pause line (Story 8.6, FR-89, UX-DR62): `paused` while a Pause is in force,
named by who set it («Pause, satt av Sara.»); `ended` from the Order that ended it until the
next Uke opens, named by who ordered («Pausen er over. Sara har bestilt.»). Never a Week
count (FR-14).
PauseOut.title: PauseOut

PlayOut.description:
The play screen's one envelope (Story 6.6, AD-3): what the Student's own Seat sees in the
open Week (`seat_state`, numbers and Roles only), the own turn (`turn`, Story 6.10) and who
sits where (`table_status`), with the server's clock. Never the number of Weeks, future
demand, another Seat's numbers or a reference Order (FR-14, FR-23).
PlayOut.title: PlayOut

PlayTurnOut.description:
The Student's own turn in the open Week (Story 6.10): whether it is a Guided Week, the
Seat's Order once placed (in a Guided Week the fixed Order, placed when the Week opened) and
whether the Student has opened the Guided Week. Never how many Guided Weeks there are.
PlayTurnOut.title: PlayTurnOut

ProposalPersonOut.description:
A Student named by the scheduling aid (Story 6.19): the name now, and whether it is the
reader. None as name for a Student no longer in the Class.
ProposalPersonOut.title: ProposalPersonOut

QuestionItemOut.description:
One Core item as the Lecturer reviews it: its type, its title (placeholder until issue
#16), its weight in force and its default, whether it is taken out, and whether it measures
quantities (taking it out warns, FR-52).
QuestionItemOut.title: QuestionItemOut

QuestionSetIn.description:
«Lagre vekter»: every Core item's weight, the items taken out and the Adapted total weight.
The weights of the items left in plus the Adapted total must be 100.
QuestionSetIn.title: QuestionSetIn

QuestionSetOut.description:
The Class session's question set selection (Story 11.1): the version it uses, whether that
version is a draft (issue #16), whether a selection saved on an older version no longer
applies (`outdated`: the latest version's defaults are shown, and pinned at the lock),
whether the lock has pinned it, whether it can still change (before the Start date), whether
the User may change it, the items and the Adapted line, and the sum of the weights in force.
QuestionSetOut.title: QuestionSetOut

QuizAttemptIn.description:
An attempt: one answer per asked question, in the order shown (422 `validation_error`
otherwise).
QuizAttemptIn.title: QuizAttemptIn

QuizAttemptOut.description:
A scored attempt (Story 9.9, FR-46): its number from 1, when it was stored, how many of the
asked questions were right and every question with its result.
QuizAttemptOut.title: QuizAttemptOut

QuizExclusionsIn.description: «Lagre quizvalg»: the ids of every question to take out; the others are asked.
QuizExclusionsIn.title: QuizExclusionsIn

QuizOut.description:
Step 5, the Debrief quiz (Story 9.9, FR-46, UX-DR37): the version the Class session pinned
at the lock, whether it is placeholder content (issue #16), the attempts so far and when it was
passed, the questions of the next attempt (the order may change between attempts; none once
passed) and the latest attempt's result.
QuizOut.title: QuizOut

QuizQuestionOut.description:
A Debrief quiz question as asked (Story 9.9): its prompt and choices in the order shown.
Never its answer key.
QuizQuestionOut.title: QuizQuestionOut

QuizResultOut.description:
One question of a scored attempt, in the order shown: the Student's choice, the right one
and, when the choice was wrong, the explanation (the content's text, then the sentence about
the Student's own Game rendered by code from the facts set of their Seat, AD-7).
QuizResultOut.title: QuizResultOut

RecordAssessmentOut.description:
The AI assessment part, as far as this branch has it: `off` when the Class session's
«KI-vurdering» switch is off, else `not_ready`. Story 12.5's «KI-vurdering» block replaces this
part. A self-enabled Indicative letter is never served to staff, so there is no field for one
(FR-56, AD-12).
RecordAssessmentOut.title: RecordAssessmentOut

RecordDebriefOut.description:
The Explanation and the Debrief summary (`debrief.service.staff_summary`): the Explanation's
text and time, and when the Debrief was finished and whether after the Debrief deadline.
RecordDebriefOut.title: RecordDebriefOut

RecordGameOut.description:
The Student's Class game (`games.service.student_game`): its id for the link to
Spillinnsikt, number, the Student's Role and where it stands (`ended`: closed without its last
Week, Story 10.6), with when it finished. `makeup`: it is the Student's finished
Oppfølgingsspill, which became their game (Story 13.5); it has no Spillinnsikt.
RecordGameOut.title: RecordGameOut

RecordMakeupOut.description:
The Student's Oppfølgingsspill (Story 13.4): its Game, when it was given, the Student's
effective Test deadline it is open until, and where it stands (`ended`: closed at that
deadline without its last Week).
RecordMakeupOut.title: RecordMakeupOut

RecordQuizAttemptOut.description: A Debrief quiz attempt: its number, time and result; never the answers.
RecordQuizAttemptOut.title: RecordQuizAttemptOut

RecordReplayOut.description: The Student's Replay Game (`replay.service.replay_game_of`) and when it finished.
RecordReplayOut.title: RecordReplayOut

RecordTestOut.description:
The Student's Individual test attempt (`tests.service.attempt_summary`): its status, when it
was handed in and which parts hold content. Never an answer.
RecordTestOut.title: RecordTestOut

ReflectionAnswerIn.description:
«Fortsett» on a reflection question: the answer as typed. It must hold more than white
space and at most 2000 characters (422 `validation_error`).
ReflectionAnswerIn.title: ReflectionAnswerIn

ReflectionAnswerOut.description:
A stored reflection answer (FR-45, AD-14): as typed, its length in characters and when it
was saved. Never changed after it is stored.
ReflectionAnswerOut.title: ReflectionAnswerOut

ReflectionOut.description:
The reflection questions between steps 3 and 4 (Story 9.6, FR-45): the version the Class
session pinned at the lock, its questions in the order asked (feelings, evidence, structure),
each with the caller's own answer only (FR-43).
ReflectionOut.title: ReflectionOut

ReflectionQuestionOut.description: One reflection question (Story 9.6) with the Student's own answer, None until answered.
ReflectionQuestionOut.title: ReflectionQuestionOut

RegistrationOut.description:
One address on the Roster with its status. `id` names the Roster entry for a reminder to
it alone; `remindable` is whether a reminder would go to it (not registered, not a hard
bounce).
RegistrationOut.title: RegistrationOut

RegistrationStatus.description:
Where a Roster address stands, read at request time; the first that applies wins.
`registered` / `registered_manually`: a Student in the Class (stored). `renewal_requested`:
the Student asked for a new Invitation from a link that no longer works. `bounced`: the mail
of its newest Invitation did not arrive (with `bounce_class`). `invited`: its newest
Invitation still works (with `last_valid_day`). `unregistered`: its newest Invitation expired
or was voided unaccepted. `not_invited`: added by hand and sent no Invitation yet (Story
4.8).
RegistrationStatus.title: RegistrationStatus

RegistrationsOut.description:
«Status etter utsending»: the totals, how many addresses have not registered («Send
påminnelse til N»), and every address by address.
RegistrationsOut.title: RegistrationsOut

ReminderIn.description:
«Send påminnelse»: to every address that has not registered, or with `roster_entry_id` to
that one alone, valid for `valid_days` (1–60, as a Roster send).
ReminderIn.title: ReminderIn

ReminderOut.description:
What the result line states: how many reminders went out, until when they work, and the
addresses left out because their last mail bounced hard (to correct or register by hand).
ReminderOut.title: ReminderOut

RenderedTextOut.description:
Text the Debrief shows as written (AD-7): code-rendered text says `ai_generated` false and
has no `llm_call_id`, and the web app shows it without the «KI-generert, kan ta feil:» prefix,
which only `ai_generated` turns on.
RenderedTextOut.title: RenderedTextOut

ReplacedLevelOut.description:
An Effort level of the source the new model config does not offer: its name, and the
source config's Norwegian label (None: show `name`).
ReplacedLevelOut.title: ReplacedLevelOut

ReplayFixed.description:
Each Week's value of `values` as the level, the last one held for Weeks beyond the series,
with variation of `spread` each Week. Resolves to a `fixed` series of the drawn length.
ReplayFixed.title: ReplayFixed

ReplayGameOut.description:
The Student's started Replay on Hjem (Story 10.3, FR-48, FR-34): its Role and Seats, every
AI player as `ai` (named «KI-spiller») from the first view, and where it stands. Never the
number of Weeks, the demand or the scenario (FR-49).
ReplayGameOut.title: ReplayGameOut

ReplayRandom.description: Demand around `mean` with variation of `spread` each Week (a `random` pattern).
ReplayRandom.title: ReplayRandom

ReplayScenarioCheckIn.description:
A draft of an own Replay scenario to judge without saving (Story 10.2): the editable
template fields, as typed. The chain, capacity and Information visibility are the Class
session's.
ReplayScenarioCheckIn.title: ReplayScenarioCheckIn

ReplaySectionOut.description: «Replay» (Story 13.10): `replay` null when the Student has no Replay.
ReplaySectionOut.title: ReplaySectionOut

ReplayStartOut.description: The Student's Replay Game: the one this request made (201) or the one they had (200).
ReplayStartOut.title: ReplayStartOut

ReplayStep.description:
`start` until the change Week, then `new_level`, with variation of `spread` each Week.
Spread 0 resolves to a `step` pattern, any other to `step+noise`.
ReplayStep.title: ReplayStep

ReplayTemplate.description:
A Replay scenario: every `GameSettings` field (the demand seed aside, which is the
Student's), whole numbers fixed or ranged.
ReplayTemplate.title: ReplayTemplate

ReplayWalkthroughOut.description:
`GET /api/me/games/{game_id}/walkthrough`. `pending`: the line is still being worded;
only `retry_after_seconds` (the rest of the wait limit) is set. `ready`: the Replay run, the
Class game beside it (None when that game was played mostly by AI players, `mostly_ai`), the

ReportDataOut.description: A Student report's content, as the print route reads it from its snapshot (AD-18).
ReportDataOut.title: ReportDataOut

ReportDatesOut.description: The Class session's dates, with the Student's own Debrief and Test deadlines.
ReportDatesOut.title: ReportDatesOut

ReportGameOut.description:
The Student's game (`games.service.student_game`) as the report documents it (FR-58):
`seat` is the Student's Seat in the game's last opened Week (its `history` the earlier
Weeks), `last_order` that Week's Order; `roles` and `demand` the whole chain in chain order
(the Role serving the customer first), as Spillinnsikt reads it (FR-34, AD-15).
ReportGameOut.title: ReportGameOut

ReportGameRoleOut.description: One Role of the chain, by Role only (never a name, AD-14), its Weeks in order.
ReportGameRoleOut.title: ReportGameRoleOut

ReportGameWeekOut.description:
One Role in one opened Week of the chain (Spillinnsikt's read, Story 7.7): its placed
Order (null for none), stored inventory and backlog, who held the Seat (`student`, `ai`, or
`free`; never who) and the marks of the one AD-15 mapping (`games.service.seat_mark`).
ReportGameWeekOut.title: ReportGameWeekOut

ReportMomentOut.description: A key moment of the Debrief summary (Story 9.8), as rendered from its facts set.
ReportMomentOut.title: ReportMomentOut

ReportReflectionOut.description: A reflection answer on evidence or structure, with its question (FR-58: never feelings).
ReportReflectionOut.title: ReportReflectionOut

ReportReplayOut.title: ReportReplayOut

ReportRunWeekOut.description: One Uke of a run: Netto lager, the Order and «Kostnad så langt» (kroner).
ReportRunWeekOut.title: ReportRunWeekOut

ReportScenarioOut.description: The Replay's own Game settings: its Replay scenario as drawn for the Student (FR-49).
ReportScenarioOut.title: ReportScenarioOut

ReportStateOut.description:
The Student's own Student report (Story 13.7, FR-57): when it opens (their effective Test
deadline; None while the Class session has none), whether it is open now, the latest
request's status, and when the PDF that can be downloaded was made (None without one).
`failed` covers a render that failed and one that never ended; a new press tries again.
ReportStateOut.title: ReportStateOut

ReportStepOut.description:
One step of the requirement: whether it counts as done, and whether a Lecturer's correction
decided it (never the reason).
ReportStepOut.title: ReportStepOut

ReportTestItemOut.description:
One item in its frozen order (Story 13.10, FR-58): its question (an Adapted item's wording,
marked when an AI worded it), a choice item's option ids, a table or drawn item's value table
or a number item's column, the saved answer (null: not answered), the item's weight and the
stored computed score as points of it (null: no computed rule scores it, or not handed in).
No criterion, explanation, answer key or AI score (FR-54, C-2).

ReportTestOut.description:
The Student's Individual test: its state, when it was handed in, every item, and the sum
of the computed scores over the items they score (`points` null when none is scored).
ReportTestOut.title: ReportTestOut

ReportTextOut.description:
Text as it is shown: `ai_generated` (only that) turns on «KI-generert, kan ta feil:» and
the machine-readable mark in the PDF (FR-34, UX-DR69). No LLM call id.
ReportTextOut.title: ReportTextOut

ResetCheckOut.description:
A usable reset link: its address, and whether the account has no password yet (a manually
registered Student, Story 4.8), so «Nytt passord» words it as a first password.
ResetCheckOut.title: ResetCheckOut

ResetEmailOut.description: The address a reset link belongs to, so «Logg inn» can be prefilled.
ResetEmailOut.title: ResetEmailOut

RevealOut.description:

code from the demand series with the pinned sentence templates, and every logged Uke of the
Student's own Seat, oldest first. Every number is the api's (AD-10).

RevealWeekOut.description:
One Uke of the reveal (Story 9.4): what the customers ordered, the Order that reached the
Student's own Seat (all they saw) and the Order they placed. From the Game's stored demand
series and the Seat's own Decision log rows.
RevealWeekOut.title: RevealWeekOut

RoleCapacityOut.description: A capped Role (Story 6.22, FR-12): the most it ships per Week, a rule of the game.
RoleCapacityOut.title: RoleCapacityOut

RoleCost.description: One Role's cost over the whole Game: a row of Kjedens regning, per Role, never per name.
RoleCost.title: RoleCost

RoleCostOut.description:
One Role's mean cost per finished Class game, split into lager and restordre (Story 7.6,
UX-DR72), in kroner rounded to the øre, as decimal strings; `total_cost` is their sum.
RoleCostOut.title: RoleCostOut

RoleIn.description: The account role an Admin grants (Story 3.9).
RoleIn.title: RoleIn

RosterEntryIn.description:
«Legg til adresse»: one address, checked as an upload's are. A refused one answers 422
`invalid_request` with `fields.email`: an address problem (`missing_at`, …) or `on_roster`.
RosterEntryIn.title: RosterEntryIn

RosterInvalidRow.description: A staged row that gets no Invitation, and why (Story 4.3).
RosterInvalidRow.title: RosterInvalidRow

RosterSendIn.description:
«Send N Invitasjoner»: the staged upload the page shows, and the validity in whole days.
A validity outside the range answers 422 `invalid_request` with
`fields.valid_days = valid_days_out_of_range`.
RosterSendIn.title: RosterSendIn

RosterSendOut.description: What the result line states: how many Invitations went out, and until when they work.
RosterSendOut.title: RosterSendOut

RosterUploadOut.description: A staged Roster upload as the Class page shows it.
RosterUploadOut.title: RosterUploadOut

SavedAnswerOut.description:
The answer stored for the item after a save: the one just sent, or the one with a higher
revision stored already (then nothing changed, and it is no error).
SavedAnswerOut.title: SavedAnswerOut

ScoringGuideIn.description:
«Lagre sensorveiledning»: the guide text of each question the Lecturer changed, by question
id. The criteria, the scale and the titles never change.
ScoringGuideIn.title: ScoringGuideIn

ScoringGuideOut.description:
The Class session's Scoring guide in force (Story 11.2): its version id and number,
whether it is a draft (issue #16), whether it is an edit made for a Class session, whether a
newer default was published after the edit (`outdated`: the edit stays in force), whether a
Control test has checked it (`content.service.is_checked`), whether the Test-deadline lock has
pinned it, whether it can still change (before the original Test deadline), whether the User
may change it, the one five-step scale and the questions.
ScoringGuideOut.title: ScoringGuideOut

SeatChoiceIn.description:
«Ta setet …»: the Seat the Student takes. Anything that names no Seat of the Class
session's games answers 422 `invalid_seat`.
SeatChoiceIn.title: SeatChoiceIn

SeatChoiceOut.description:
«Velg spill og sete» (Story 5.17): the Class session's Class games with their Seats, and
the reader's own Seat. Never the Game settings, the number of Weeks or the demand.
SeatChoiceOut.title: SeatChoiceOut

SeatChoiceSeatOut.description:
One Seat as «Velg spill og sete» lists it: free, a Student (named now; None once removed
from the Class) or, after the lock, an AI player. `mine` marks the reader's own Seat.
SeatChoiceSeatOut.title: SeatChoiceSeatOut

SeatMark.description:
What a Seat's row says beyond its holder (AD-15, Story 6.14), from the one mapping
`games.service.seat_mark`. Story 7.7 adds a mark for every other occupancy `reason` and every
`fallback` (FR-34, FR-62).
SeatMark.title: SeatMark

SeatRef.description: A Seat named by its Class game's number and its Role: «Grossist i Spill 17».
SeatRef.title: SeatRef

SeatState.description:
What one Seat sees in one opened Week: the single information boundary (AD-3, FR-23).

The play screen, the LLM player's prompt and the Decision log (`state_seen`) all read this
model, and a field is added here, never beside it. It holds numbers and Roles only: no
names, no number of Weeks, no future demand and no other Seat's state beyond the
`neighbour_numbers` that Information visibility allows: the direct neighbours' inventory and
backlog in the open Week, filled by `games.views.build_seat_state` while
`FEATURE_INFO_VISIBILITY` is on (Story 6.21).
Every number comes from `engine.seat_view` and `engine.seat_detail`; engine functions that
take a `SeatView` accept this model as it is.

Version 2 (Story 6.6) adds `net_inventory` to the Week and to each `history` row, for the
play screen's Netto lager. Version 3 (Story 6.7) adds `holding_cost` and `backorder_cost` to
each `history` row, for the graph's Kost per uke bars. Version 4 (Story 6.16) adds the running
sums for «Kostnad så langt»: `total_holding_cost` and `total_backorder_cost` on the Week, and
`total_cost`, `total_holding_cost` and `total_backorder_cost` on each `history` row. A stored
version 1, 2 or 3 state reads as version 4.
SeatState.title: SeatState

SentMessageOut.description: One Message in «Meldinger» (Story 7.10): its recipient, sender, time and reach.
SentMessageOut.title: SentMessageOut

SessionRole.description:
The roles a session carries (`UserOut.roles`): the account roles, and `assistant` while the
User is Assistant lecturer of at least one Class (Story 4.9). `assistant` is read from the
Class staff on every request, never stored or granted by the Admin.
SessionRole.title: SessionRole

SettingProblem.description:
Why one Game setting is refused (Story 5.3, FR-12): the engine's stable code and the range
that applies, its bounds as decimal strings («1», «100.00»), or None when the rule has none.
SettingProblem.title: SettingProblem

SettingWarning.description:
A legal but unusual Game setting (FR-12): the engine's code, the setting it stands under,
and the numbers behind it as decimal strings. It never blocks a save.
SettingWarning.title: SettingWarning

SettingsCheckIn.description:
A draft of the Game settings to judge without saving: the editable settings, laid
over the stored settings. Values are sent as typed, so the engine judges them all.
SettingsCheckIn.title: SettingsCheckIn

SettingsCheckOut.description:
What the engine says of a draft (FR-12): the errors by setting, which block a save, and the
warnings, which do not.
SettingsCheckOut.title: SettingsCheckOut

SharedChainOut.description:
The whole chain as the shared screen draws it: four Roles, Fabrikk first, and the chain's
cost («Kjeden»).
SharedChainOut.title: SharedChainOut

SharedOut.description:
«Delt skjerm: hele kjeden» (Story 9.13, FR-74, AD-21): a Group debrief's shared charts by
Role, for a joined Student's display. Never a name, a user id, an Explanation, a reflection
answer, a moment or any free text: the schema has no text field at all. `locked` while a joined
Student has not sent their Explanation, and then `chain` is None (no demand, no chain data,
FR-43). `step` is the group's shared pointer.

get.description: One Class session, for the Klasseøkt screen. Its Class's Assistant lecturers read it too.

put.description:
«Lagre Klasseøkt»: saves the Class session as it stands. LLM players while no model config
is pinned as the default answer 409 `llm_unavailable`, and nothing changes.

With `dates` the four dates are replaced (FR-18). `fields` names each date in question:
422 `invalid_dates` (`past`, `order` for the later date of a pair out of order, `before` for
the earlier one when only it changed, `required` once locked), 409 `deadline_passed`
(`passed`). Dates count to the whole minute.

`effort_level`, `debrief_mode`, `debrief_release` and `debrief_ai_text` (FR-15, FR-16, FR-42,
FR-78), left out, keep their values; a changed `debrief_release` or `debrief_ai_text` once
locked answers 409 `session_locked` too. With LLM
players a changed Effort level the model config does not offer answers 422
`invalid_effort_level` (`{"effort_level": "not_offered"}`); with Rule-based players no level
is in force and a sent one is ignored. Once the Start date has passed, a changed AI mode,
Effort level or Debrief mode answers 409 `session_locked`, `fields` naming each.

With `game_settings` (the editable settings, laid over the stored ones; `demand` and
`demand_seed` too) the engine judges the settings (FR-12, FR-13): 422 `invalid_settings` with
`fields` mapping each setting (`demand.<field>` inside the Demand pattern) to
`{code, minimum, maximum, decimal_places}`. Once locked, changed settings answer 409
`session_locked` (`{"game_settings": "locked"}`).

`game_settings.capacity` (Story 5.15) is `{role: units}` or null: one Role or every Role
capped per Week, `capacity.<role>` from 1 to 100. While `FEATURE_CAPACITY` is off a
non-empty capacity answers 422 `feature_disabled` (`{"capacity": "feature_disabled"}`).

`game_settings.info_visibility` (Story 5.16) is `{upstream, downstream}`, two booleans that
let each Seat see its neighbour's inventory and backlog; anything else is `info_visibility`
`invalid`. While `FEATURE_INFO_VISIBILITY` is off a view switched on answers 422
`feature_disabled` (`{"info_visibility": "feature_disabled"}`).

`obligatory`, `required_share_percent` and `inactivity_limit_hours` (Story 5.7, FR-17,
FR-36), left out, keep their values. A changed share outside 1 to 100 or Inactivity limit
under 20 hours answers 422 `invalid_session_values` (`out_of_range`, `below_minimum`); once
locked a changed one answers 409 `session_locked`. Switching the mark on tells each
registered Student through the day's digest mail.

`allocation_method` (Story 5.17, FR-21), left out, keeps the method. `student_choice` creates
empty Class games for the registered Students and tells each of them through the day's digest
mail that they may choose a Class game and a Seat. A changed method answers 422
`feature_disabled` (`{"allocation_method": "feature_disabled"}`) for Student choice while
`FEATURE_STUDENT_CHOICE` is off, 409 `session_locked` once locked and 409
`allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation_method": "confirmed"}`) once an allocation is confirmed:
Student choice is final once saved.

`replay_scenario` (Story 10.2, FR-49), left out, keeps the Replay scenario: `default`, or
`own` with `replay_template`, the own scenario's editable fields (`starting_inventory`,
`starting_backlog`, `supply_line`, the three delays, `weeks`, `guided_weeks`, `max_order` as
whole numbers or `{minimum, maximum}`; `holding_cost`, `backorder_cost`; `demand` as `step`
with a ranged `change_week`, `random` or `fixed`, each with a `spread`; `info_visibility`
as in the Game settings, the Replay's own, Story 10.9), laid over the Class game's exact
settings (Information visibility: over a stored own template's). A template the engine
refuses answers 422 `invalid_replay_scenario` with `fields` as `invalid_settings`; while
`FEATURE_INFO_VISIBILITY` is off a view switched on there names `info_visibility`
`feature_disabled`; `own` with no template sent or stored names
`replay_template` `required`. Once locked, a changed scenario answers 409 `session_locked`
(`{"replay_scenario": "locked"}`).

`ai_assessment` (Story 12.1, FR-61), left out, keeps the «KI-vurdering» switch. It can change
after the Start date too; once the original Test deadline has passed (and the Test-deadline
lock has pinned it) a changed value answers 409 `ai_assessment_pinned`
(`{"ai_assessment": "pinned"}`). Only the Class's owners change it (`ai_assessment.change`).

`test_sitting` (Story 11.12, FR-51), left out, keeps the Individual test's one timed sitting:
`{"minutes": n}` sets the time limit in whole minutes, `{"minutes": null}` switches it off. A
limit outside the configured range answers 422 `invalid_session_values`
(`{"test_sitting_minutes": "out_of_range"}`); once locked a change answers 409
`session_locked` (`{"test_sitting": "locked"}`).

get.description:
The Adapted item preview (Story 11.9, FR-53, UX-DR70): each template of the version the
Class session pins, filled by code from the static sample facts set («Demodata»), with its
weight of the Adapted total in force. No Game, no stored facts set, no LLM call.

The «Fordeling» block (Story 5.8, FR-20): the registered Students, those not in the draft,
and the stored draft (None until one is drawn) with the Students' names read now. For the
Class's staff, Assistant lecturers too.

post.description:
Opening «Fordeling»: the stored draft unchanged, or, when none is stored, a draft drawn at
random from the registered Students in groups of four with a random Role each. With no
registered Student nothing is stored. No Game or Seat is created and no Student is told.
Once the Start date has passed a stored draft is still returned, and a draw answers 409
`session_locked` (`{"allocation": "locked"}`). An archived Class answers 409
`class_archived`.

«Bekreft fordeling» (Story 5.9, FR-20): commits the draft named by `draft_id` and
`revision`, and nothing else: one Class game per group and one Seat per Student, and each
Student is told through the day's digest mail. Pressing it again changes nothing.

409 `allocation_changed` commits no Game: `{"draft": "changed"}` when the draft is no longer
the current one (drawn again or changed), `{"draft": "students_removed"}` when Students in it
have left the Roster, whose Seats the draft now leaves free under a raised revision. 409
`session_locked` (`{"allocation": "locked"}`) once the Start date has passed; 409
`class_archived` for an archived Class.

Move a Student to a free Seat, or swap two (Story 5.10, FR-20), in the draft named by
`draft_id` and `revision`: the Student of `from_game`/`from_role` takes
`to_game`/`to_role`, and a Student there takes the first Seat. The draft keeps its id and
its revision rises by one. Once the allocation is confirmed the Class games change in the
same transaction and the Students who moved are told through the day's digest mail.

409 `allocation_changed` (`{"draft": "changed"}`) when the draft is no longer the current
one; 422 `invalid_move` with `fields` `{"to": "same"}`, `{"from"|"to": "unknown"}`,
`{"from": "empty"}` or `{"from": "last_student"}`; 409 `session_locked` (`{"allocation":
"locked"}`) once the Start date has passed; 409 `class_archived` for an archived Class.
A confirmed allocation's Games refusing the move answer the command's code (such as 409
`game_already_started`). A session with Student choice (Story 5.17) answers 409
`allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation": "student_choice"}`). Nothing is committed on any
refusal.

«Kjør fordeling på nytt»: a new seed and a new draft under a new id, revision 1. The
refusals are those of opening it, and 409 `allocation_confirmed` (`{"allocation":
"confirmed"}`) once the allocation is confirmed.

get.description:

still change (until the Test deadline). For the Class's owners and Assistant lecturers; 403
`forbidden` for every other caller.

put.description:
«Lagre quizvalg» (Story 9.10, FR-46, AD-23, AD-15): the questions to take out of the Class
session's Debrief quiz, the whole set; the others are asked. Stored as Class session rows and
recorded in the audit log; a Student who has not passed answers only the rest on their next
attempt, and one whose last attempt it now covers is told. No Student is passed by it. 409
`last_question` when no question would be asked, `test_deadline_passed` after the Class
session's Test deadline, `class_archived` for an archived Class; 422 `validation_error` for an
id the quiz does not have; 403 `forbidden` for an Assistant lecturer and every other caller.

get.description:
